name: differential_meander
promptTemplate: Differential growth coral loop shaped in {{form_style}} style with {{palette}} pigments, {{growth_speed}} expansion pace, and {{line_weight}}px contours.

form_style.hint: Swaps tension and spring physics for deep meanders

palette.hint: Tints the undulating spline and bioluminescent fill

growth_speed.hint: Controls repulsion force and node splitting speed

line_weight.hint: Adjusts perimeter ridge thickness on the wall

gallery.blurb: Differential growth: a single closed line of nodes that repel, cling to their neighbours and split when stretched, folding into a coral- or brain-like form that keeps growing within a fixed budget of nodes.
gallery.prompt: Differential growth: a single closed line of nodes that repel, cling to their neighbours and split when stretched, folding into a coral- or brain-like form that keeps growing within a fixed budget of nodes. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
